commit.message:
feat(app): confirm module installs and allow cancelling downloads

Installing from the online list now always asks first, whether it is a
first install or a replacement of an older version, and the dialog names
the version it is about to write.

A download in flight can be cancelled from the progress dialog (or by
tapping outside it): the transfer is aborted at the socket, the partial
file is deleted, the fallback address is not retried, and nothing is
installed.

+/**
+ * Cancels a download in flight. The transfer is aborted at the socket, so a
+ * cancelled download stops costing bandwidth at once — and it is never retried
+ * by a fallback address, because the user asked for it to stop.
+ */
+class DownloadCancelHandle {
+    @Volatile
+    private var call: Call? = null
+
+    @Volatile
+    var isCancelled = false
+        private set
+
+    fun cancel() {
+        isCancelled = true
+        call?.cancel()
+    }
+
+    internal fun attach(call: Call) {
+        this.call = call
+        // A cancel that arrived before the request was handed to OkHttp still
+        // has to take effect.
+        if (isCancelled) call.cancel()
+    }
+}
